g.text: A Needs approach a steady state
Arrows = local change; markers = starts; star = endpoint. Four paths fit in A; all six appear in B.
Germany conditional planner: growing quality and steady needs coexist. No global stability theorem is claimed.

svg.title: phase growth
svg.desc: Needs settle while quality continues along the tested balanced-growth rays.
